Three days. You walk out with a working **AI assistant you set up yourself**, **3–5
automations** running on your own everyday work, and one number: the **hours you win back
each week**. Not a search engine — a teammate that drafts, summarizes, and calculates.

**Hands-on tool:** Claude Cowork. **No coding** — you describe steps in plain language.
Every concept is portable: the same idea shows up in Antigravity, Hermes, ChatGPT, Gemini,
and NotebookLM. We show one tool; the workflow transfers.

## The Delivery Loop

**Show** (instructor demo) → **Build** (you apply it to a real task from your backlog) →
**Refine** (quick group critique: "I like / I wish / I wonder"). Aim for ~70% hands-on.

## Two Rules We Never Break

- **Newspaper Test** — guards what you *paste in*. Sanitize confidential or personal data
  before it goes anywhere.
- **Blast Radius / Human-in-the-Loop** — guards what the agent *does*. Start every Skill,
  schedule, and connector in **draft / notify-me** mode before letting it act on its own.

All hands-on agent work runs in a **sandbox folder with dummy data**.
